overview: The screens, menus and keys the other mods here use to talk to you.
Press N for questions waiting on you, J for action menus, /pandorical mods for the rest.

15.1.0: Notices: a mod can put a question to a player in a tray of its own — a teleport request, an invitation, an offer to trade — instead of in the chat everybody is talking in.
The death screen's buttons now arm on the clock as well as on ticks, so a client that has stopped ticking can still respawn instead of sitting on a dead screen.
A horse turns the way you press. Left was turning it right, and it turned at a boat's pace; it now answers at a horse's.
A block the client builds from the server's description starts with its flags off, so a grass slab no longer flashes white for a frame as it is placed.
15.0.0: Action menus: grids of buttons on one key. Press J, or set your own.
The mods screen lists what you are running and can switch your own mods off.
Notices: questions from mods wait in a tray on N instead of scrolling past in chat.
